troubleshooting_and_watchouts: 10R80 CDF Clutch Drum Bushing: Monitor for harsh 3-4 and 7-8 upshifts or delayed reverse engagement; updated Ford CDF drum (JL3Z-7H351-B) has internal retaining lip to prevent bushing displacement.
MERCON ULV vs MERCON LV Warning: Automatic transmission 10R80 strictly requires MERCON ULV. Standard MERCON LV will degrade clutch friction packs and destroy valve body solenoids.
NHTSA Recall (Fuel Tank Mounting): Verify fuel tank support strap torque and corrosion resistance to prevent detachment or fuel line strain.
Trailer Brake Controller (ITRM) Communication: Inspect integrated trailer relay module; software calibration fix prevents loss of trailer electric brake signal.

Heavy Towing / Bobcat 743 Transport: Real-world payload is ~1,800 lbs. Trailer tongue weight (10-15%) consumes payload directly. Must use Class IV Weight-Distribution Hitch with spring bars and 4-point Grade 70 5/16' transport chain tie-downs at 45 deg angles per 49 CFR 393.130.
5.0L Coyote Oil Monitoring: Check dipstick every 1,500 miles. Severe duty 5,000-mile interval prevents timing chain tensioner sludge.

10R60 Transmission Harsh Shifts: TSB 20-2277 / 21-2249 reprogrammed PCM/TCM shift adaptives for harsh 1-2 upshifts and 3-1 deceleration clunks.
Degas Bottle & Water Pump Micro-Cracks: 2.3L external water pump and plastic degas bottle seam prone to micro-cracks; inspect monthly for sweet coolant odor or crust.
PTU Fluid Degradation: Power Transfer Unit sits adjacent to exhaust downpipe; service PTU fluid every 30,000–45,000 miles to prevent bearing starvation.
360-Degree Camera Blue Screen: Recall 23V598000 addressed image processing module failure.

troubleshooting_and_watchouts: A33 VQ30DE-K Idle Air Control Valve (IACV) Coolant Leak Onto ECU: The #1 catastrophic failure on 2000-2001 I30/Maxima. IACV gasket degrades, letting engine coolant drip directly into stepper motor coils. This shorts the motor and sends a high-voltage surge back into the ECU, frying the STA509A MOSFET chip on the motherboard. Fix: Loop/bypass the 5/16' coolant lines to the IACV or replace gasket immediately.

VQ37VHR Rear Timing Cover Oil Gallery Gaskets: Pre-2013 VQ37VHR paper gallery gaskets blow out behind the front timing cover, dropping hot idle oil pressure and throwing VTC codes (P0011/P0021). Fix: EPS / CZP reinforced metal-backed gaskets with Allen bolts.
Serpentine Belt Alignment & Chirp: Inspect idler pulleys and automatic belt tensioner; listen for cold startup chirp indicating pulley bearing dry-out.
Electronic Steering Column Lock (ESCL): Steering lock actuator motor jams, leaving car stranded in 'LOCK'. Preventative: Pull steering lock fuse in IPDM while in ACC mode.

specs.breakaway_battery_voltage: Must test > 12.4V before every towing event; replace battery every 2-3 years

specs.tire_replacement_rule: Strict 5 to 6 year replacement lifecycle regardless of remaining tread depth (UV/ozone dry-rot)
specs.lug_nut_torque: 90 - 120 lb-ft (Retorque at 25, 50, and 100 miles after any wheel removal)

troubleshooting_and_watchouts: Subfloor Wood Rot Under Rubber Stall Mats: The #1 cause of catastrophic livestock transport accidents. Horse urine and wash-down water contain acid and ammonia that pool beneath heavy rubber mats. The acid rots treated 2x8 dimensional lumber and corrodes steel crossmembers invisibly until a horse steps through the floor during highway transit. Mandatory: Pull stall mats every 6 months, scrape debris, probe wood with awl, pressure wash, sun-dry completely, and seal with wood preservative.

Electric Brake Shoe Adjustment & Magnet Wear: Uneven braking causes trailer to shove truck sideways during panic stops. Inspect magnet faces for annular wear grooves. Adjust star-wheel shoe clearance: rotate jacked wheel, tighten until shoes drag, then back off 7-10 clicks until wheel spins freely with slight whisper.
Breakaway Lanyard & Battery Freeze: In winter, 12V SLA battery freezes and drops below 10.5V. Test with multimeter before every haul; pull pin manually to confirm all 4 brakes lock solid.

Tongue Weight & Weight Distribution: Tongue weight must be 10-15% of gross trailer weight. For heavy loads (> 5,000 lbs), engage weight-distribution spring bars to level truck headlights and restore front axle steering authority.

identifiers.cutting_deck: 50 in or 54 in AeroForce Fabricated 11-Gauge Triple-Blade Deck
identifiers.engine_options: Kohler 7000 Series V-Twin (KT725/735 22-24 HP) or Kawasaki FR691V (23 HP)
identifiers.transmissions: Dual Hydro-Gear EZT-2200 or ZT-2800 Hydrostatic Transaxles

specs.engine_oil: 1.8 - 2.0 qts SAE 10W-30 (or SAE 20W-50 / 10W-40 in summer > 85 deg F)
specs.air_filter: Dual-stage pleated paper cartridge + oiled foam pre-cleaner (Kohler 16-083-04-S / Kawasaki 11013-0752)
specs.spark_plugs: Champion RC12YC or NGK BPR4ES (Gap: 0.030 in / 0.76 mm, Torque: 18-22 lb-ft)
specs.cutting_blades: 3-Blade set high-lift mulching/discharge (Torque spindle center bolts to 70-90 lb-ft)
specs.deck_belt: Cub Cadet OEM Kevlar-wrapped belt (Part # 954-04329A for 54 in / 954-04328 for 50 in)
specs.tire_pressures: Front Casters: 20-25 PSI | Rear Drive Wheels: 10-12 PSI (Critical: Must be matched L/R for tracking)
specs.spindle_grease: NLGI No. 2 Multi-Purpose Lithium Grease (3 deck spindle zerks + 2 front caster pivot zerks)
specs.pto_clutch_air_gap: 0.012 in feeler gauge through 3 adjustment slots

troubleshooting_and_watchouts: Hydrostatic Tracking Drift (Veering Left/Right): If mower pulls to one side when pushing both lap bars full forward, do NOT adjust control linkages first. Check rear tire pressure first. A 2 PSI difference between rear drive tires causes immediate steering pull. If tires are exactly 10-12 PSI, adjust the linkage stop bolts or dampener nuts under the seat.

Electric PTO Clutch Slip & High Air Gap: If blades fail to engage or slip under tall grass load, check the electric PTO clutch air gap. Insert a 0.012-inch feeler gauge through the 3 perimeter slots; tighten the 3 spring-loaded adjustment nuts evenly until slight drag is felt.

Ethanol Phase Separation & Carburetor Gelling: Ethanol-blended fuel sitting in the float bowl during winter separates, causing water corrosion and brass pilot jet clogging (engine surges or only runs on choke). Use ethanol-free 91+ gas or add Sta-Bil/Sea Foam; drain float bowl before winter mothballing.
Grass Caking Under Deck: Compacted thatch under the deck restricts air velocity, dulls blade tips, and overloads the Kevlar deck belt. Scrape deck underside every 15 operating hours.
